# Ultimate ASI Loader runtime

This folder contains the x86 `dinput8.dll` from Ultimate ASI Loader v10.0.2, downloaded from the official upstream `Ultimate-ASI-Loader-NoPDB.zip` release asset:

<https://github.com/ThirteenAG/Ultimate-ASI-Loader/releases/tag/v10.0.2>

SHA-256 of the upstream ZIP: `C8CB367641DE962CB10BE44786359A23BE013C4F96962EB8120FF237F1561139`

SHA-256 of `dinput8.dll`: `F0E76C41B6D96270B33DD8C0E27822A5EFB631C839EC9A6671AB449F2FCA28A1`

The installer copies this loader only when the selected game folder has no `dinput8.dll`; it does not replace an existing proxy loader. The MIT license is included as `LICENSE.txt`.
